notes:
- The cover grows out of the poster you tapped, and shrinks back into it: Opening a cover used to fade a full-screen dialog in and scale its artwork up in place, and closing it waited a fixed 220ms and then deleted the dialog - so the picture could vanish halfway through its own bounce. The viewer now keeps the rectangle the poster occupied in the window, draws one travelling copy of the artwork at the pager's measured frame, and animates that copy from the tapped rectangle to 1:1 on a spring; dismissing runs the same spring backwards and only then tears the dialog down. The platform's dim is switched off as well, because a black cut under the app's own fading scrim is what made the entrance read as a flash rather than a reveal. The saved rectangle is the sheet's window frame, the same full-screen frame the dialog uses, so the hand-off needs no shared-element API.
- A title's page is backed by its own blurred artwork: The Info page below the hero was a flat surface, so the artwork stopped at the fold and everything under it looked like a different screen. The page can now be backed by the title's banner or its cover, blurred in place and scrimmed with the theme's surface colour,
